# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers using Visual Studio/Microsoft build tools for this project and does not want to use CMake for now; they may consider CMake and cross-platform build tooling later.
- When editing existing code, preserve replaced lines as comments instead of deleting them entirely.
- Only ever change one thing at a time between tests during debugging.
- Track and label debug comments with a human readable date/time label for later retracing of steps.
